changelog:
- Added direct agent wallet creation via `engine_miner_wallet_create`, with explicit user warning about displaying the recovery phrase in chat.
- Updated post-install and wallet creation guidance to include new creation method and emphasize recovery phrase backup.
- Clarified that manual wallet creation now uses `node ./dist/admin.js init`.
- Expanded safety rules to ensure recovery phrase is only revealed once after warning and confirmation.
- Updated list of available commands to add `engine_miner_wallet_create` to the tool surface.
- Revised first reply and refusal patterns to match new wallet creation workflows and reinforce security best practices.
